title: 第21章 赤果果的挑衅第22章 心腹再次算计
slug: 绑定全国每人每天给我一两银
lines: 夜色渐暗。
众人行至一处山谷中，开始安营扎寨。
营帐里，陆舟正坐在案几前看着流云商会所提供的云州情报。
上次只是粗略看过，后来虽然偶有涉猎，但看得还是很少。
今日见到这群流民之后，他便又将其翻开了。
这一次，他看的是妖族的信息。
大周与古越妖族之间，向来势同水火。
曾经陆舟的爷爷还御驾亲征，讨伐过古越妖族，让他们老实了一段时间。
但随着北方蛮子和西边大夏的频繁骚扰，再加上当今武皇的无能，才导致妖族又开始肆无忌惮了。
“护越都府和州兵竟然毫无作为！”陆舟看向云州的军事信息，眉头一皱。
大周在云州这样的封地，主要军事力量由州兵和中央兵组成。
州兵是云州内部的军事力量，直接对刺史负责，理应是对抗妖族的主要力量，没想到竟然任由妖族祸害云州。
而中央兵，属于护越都府，乃是大周为了安抚防备古越小国的军队，直接朝廷负责，但他们也同样对妖族之祸坐视不管。
两者都不作为，才让妖族愈发肆无忌惮。
除了上述两股军师力量外，还有一股特殊军事力量——王爷府护卫。
这应该是隶属于陆舟的军队，帮助他管理云州。
不过，它却有名无实。
陆舟现在只是一个孤家寡人罢了。
这也是为何朝堂那些皇子会将自己赶到这里的原因之一。
没兵就没权！
想到这里，陆舟的心思落在了外面那六十多名甲士身上。
这些人，或许是他唯一有机会掌控的。
唯有先掌控他们，才能在入驻云城后有资本抢占话语权，并在之后有机会与中央兵和州兵制衡。
而想要掌控这六十名甲士，关键还是在刘傲身上！
正思索着，帘帐掀开，柳仙儿端着晚膳进来了：“王爷，请用膳。”
“外面那些流民如何了？”陆舟询问道。
“刚才看了一眼，应该没什么事。”柳仙儿柔声道。
她弄晚膳的时候，发现流民都在井然有序地排队。
陆舟微微颔首。
他正吃着，忽然周川急步闯入，拱手道：“王爷，刘傲想要抓人。”
陆舟眉头一皱：“怎么回事？”
周川当即将事情来龙去脉一一告知。
原来是今天他正看管流民吃饭的时候，刘傲的心腹马六忽然来了，然后看了几下后，忽然找到了一名女子便要将其带走。
周川自然是不能同意，当即拦住。
对方表示这是刘傲的意思，但周川依旧没有松口。
僵持一番后，对方不甘离去。
但周川觉得不对劲，于是乎让李雄守着，自己先来禀告。
“女人？”陆舟沉吟一声，立刻猜到了对方的意图，脸色陡冷：“这刘傲还真是肆无忌惮！”
这时，外界忽然传来一阵骚乱……
帐内三人皆是脸色微变。
陆舟立刻起身，朝着帐外走去。
刚刚来到流民所在的地方，他便见到李雄竟然被人一脚踢飞，摔在了人群中央。
“刘傲！”陆舟脸色陡沉，高声道：“你在做什么？”
此刻的刘傲一脸不屑地扫了眼地上的李雄，骂了句：“一个废物，还敢忤逆老子！”
content_en:
The night is getting dark.
Everyone walked to a valley and began to set up camp.
In the camp, Lu Zhou was sitting in front of the desk and looking at the Yunzhou information provided by the Liuyun Chamber of Commerce.
I only took a brief look at it last time. Although I occasionally dabbled in it later, I still saw very little.
After seeing this group of refugees today, he opened it again.
This time, he was looking at the information from the demon clan.
The Great Zhou Dynasty and the Guyue Demon Clan have always been at odds with each other.
Once upon a time, Lu Zhou's grandfather even went on a personal expedition to defeat the Ancient Yue Monster Clan and kept them honest for a period of time.
However, with the frequent harassment by the barbarians in the north and Daxia in the west, coupled with the incompetence of the current Emperor Wu, the demon clan began to act unscrupulously again.
"The Protectorate and the state soldiers did nothing!" Lu Zhou looked at Yunzhou's military information and frowned.
In a fiefdom like Yunzhou, the main military force of the Great Zhou Dynasty consisted of state soldiers and central soldiers.
The state soldiers are the internal military force of Yunzhou and are directly responsible to the governor. They are supposed to be the main force against the demon clan. Unexpectedly, they allow the demon clan to harm Yunzhou.
The Central Army, belonging to the Protectorate of Yue, was directly responsible to the imperial court in order to appease and defend the small country of Ancient Yue. However, they also sat aside and ignored the evils of the demon clan.
The failure of both made the demon clan become more and more unscrupulous.
In addition to the above two military forces, there is also a special military force - the Royal Guards.
This should be an army affiliated with Lu Zhou, helping him manage Yunzhou.
However, it is in name only.
Lu Zhou is just a loner now.
This is one of the reasons why the princes in the court drove themselves here.
Without soldiers, there is no power!
Thinking of this, Lu Zhou's mind fell on the more than sixty soldiers outside.
These people may be the only ones he has a chance to control.
Only by controlling them first can we have the capital to seize the right to speak after settling in Yuncheng, and then have the opportunity to check and balance with the central and state soldiers.
And if you want to control these sixty soldiers, the key lies in Liu Ao!
Just as he was thinking about it, the curtain opened and Liu Xian'er came in with dinner: "Your Majesty, please have a meal."
"How are the refugees outside?" Lu Zhou asked.
"I took a look just now. It should be fine." Liu Xian'er said softly.
When she was preparing dinner, she found that the refugees were queuing up in an orderly manner.
Lu Zhou nodded slightly.
While he was eating, Zhou Chuan suddenly rushed in and said, "Your Majesty, Liu Ao wants to arrest someone."
Lu Zhou frowned: "What's going on?"
Zhou Chuan immediately informed him of the ins and outs of the matter.
It turned out that today when he was watching the refugees eat, Liu Ao's confidant Ma Liu suddenly came. After looking at her for a few times, he suddenly found a woman and wanted to take her away.
Zhou Chuan naturally couldn't agree and stopped him immediately.
The other party said that this was what Liu Ao meant, but Zhou Chuan still did not let go.
After a stalemate, the other party was unwilling to leave.
But Zhou Chuan felt something was wrong, so he asked Li Xiong to guard him while he reported the matter first.
"Woman?" Lu Zhou groaned, and immediately guessed the other party's intention, his face turned cold: "This Liu Ao is really unscrupulous!"
At this time, there was a sudden commotion outside...
The faces of the three people in the tent changed slightly.
Lu Zhou immediately stood up and walked outside the tent.
As soon as he arrived at the place where the refugees were, he saw that Li Xiong was kicked away and fell into the middle of the crowd.
"Liu Ao!" Lu Zhou's face darkened and he shouted, "What are you doing?"
At this moment, Liu Ao glanced at Li Xiong on the ground with disdain and cursed: "How dare you disobey me, a loser!"
